versions.content: Semantics of Limit Technically, a Limit specifies a bound- ary of the interval of valid values for a given context (i.e. a data type). Please note that the boundary might or might not be part of the interval itself, i.e. the interval might be open or closed. From the formal point of view, the range represents all real numbers defined by: range = { x ∈ ℜ ∥ lowerLimit.value < x < upperLimit.value } ∪{ lowerLimit.value ∥ lowerLimit.intervalT ype == “ CLOSED ′′ } ∪{ upperLimit.value ∥ upperLimit.intervalT ype == “ CLOSED ′′ }
